product.name: Sunofriend
product.independence: Unsigned Media Ltd project; not related to or affiliated with Suno Inc.

agent_entry.preferred_surface: Codex or another agent with explicit local workspace and command access
agent_entry.standard_chat_boundary: A standard ChatGPT conversation may guide but must not claim local execution.
two_turn_start: Use $skill-installer to install the official skill. Do not install the app or audio dependencies. Confirm availability, then stop.
Use $sunofriend in a new turn. Inspect first, explain changes, then offer the three newcomer routes.

installation_protocol.stage_1: Run the read-only plan. If source is absent, ask before preparing only the source checkout.
installation_protocol.stage_2: Rerun the plan, show the exact 40-character commit, and ask separately before installing that same reviewed commit.

newcomer_routes.action: for agent-led work use sunofriend create PROJECT --out-dir FRESH; prefer Simple / Make my song when the person operates the TUI
explain DAW export or independent authorised stem services; Sunofriend does not separate
create copyright-safe synthetic stems and run the normal automatic MIDI/WAV/ZIP path in a fresh output directory

stem_inputs.stem_definition: a grouped submix such as drums, bass, vocals or keys; not necessarily one isolated instrument
stem_inputs.ai_separated_stem_definition: an estimate of a category from a finished mix, not the lost original studio track
stem_inputs.multi_format_import_scope: one authorised supported local audio asset per source-import execution

agent_create.audience: newcomer working through a local agent

studio.candidates: multiple analytical, AI and repair methods remain separate

advanced_capabilities: vocal melody transcription, consensus, phrase review and bounded correction
key, BPM, tuning, anchoring and alignment transforms
sample instrument analysis, matching and instrument bundles
Clip v1 cataloguing, reuse and transformation
multi-method analytical, tracker, optional local-AI and repaired candidate comparison
